method: CUA browser CSS metrics, native JPEG scene captures and contiguous full-reader parts at 390/360; actual in-app scroll of image-reference reader also verified. Embedded/source/native artwork checked separately for byte equality.

visual_review.scope: Strips 19 and 21 visually reviewed at both CSS widths; adjacent strips 20/22 recaptured at both widths. Unchanged first 18 retain their earlier reviewed phone captures.
visual_review.limitations: Browser captures only; no physical device or user approval. Visual legibility is not proof of comprehension or empathy.

browser_recovery: The embedded 22-strip reader exceeded the native accessibility snapshot size; compact read-only DOM metrics and native image captures verified its complete content. Image-reference reader supports native PageDown actions. Viewport screenshots returned blank after deep anchor navigation, so the actual DOM scroll offsets were captured through the native screenshot clip API.

scroll_observations.method: Native PageDown actions and browser captures of the resulting CSS viewport extent
